text.card: A star about 100 parsecs away, 1.1 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.1 solar radii and 1.06 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,960 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: Krios and Kronos
quotes.card: Originally designated HD 240430 is a Sun-like star in appearance, but it seems to have eaten its own planets, for which it is given the nickname Kronos, after the Greek god and the leader of the first generation of Titans.
quotes.introduction: Its unusual properties were described by a team of astrophysicists at Princeton University in 2017, led by Semyeong Oh.
